Stock market news | Jupiter Wagons signs JV for metro coaches and propulsion systems

Jupiter Wagons signed a framework agreement with South Korea's Woojin Industrial Systems to set up a joint venture that will manufacture metro coaches and propulsion systems in India.
The partnership gives Jupiter an 80% stake and funding, while Woojin will provide technology transfer, technical support and core components, potentially strengthening India's railway manufacturing capabilities.
